records.title: Meeting Facilitation Principles
records.content: Core principles for effective research review meetings at Brightline: 1) Begin with participant safety and consent verification, 2) Use parking lot for tangential methodology discussions, 3) Maintain decision log for action items, 4) Distribute pre-reads 48 hours in advance. Raw notes must remain in encrypted workspace only, never in shared drives.
records.author: Linh Nguyen

records.title: Research Participant Recruitment Criteria
records.content: Inclusion criteria for B2B SaaS usability studies: Minimum 6 months active platform usage, current role in purchasing or daily decision-making capacity, located in US/Canada timezones. Exclusions: Current Brightline contractors, immediate family of employees, competitors with active NDAs. Incentive structure: $150 digital gift card or equivalent charity donation via Tremendous.
records.author: Linh Nguyen

records.title: Product Operations Workflow Standards
records.content: Quarterly research roadmap intake: Product managers submit via Coda form by week 3 of preceding quarter. Research Ops reviews for capacity fit, participant availability, and ethical compliance. Output: Prioritized queue with estimated timelines published in shared research calendar. Emergency requests require VP of Product approval and must displace existing work with stakeholder notification.
records.author: Linh Nguyen

records.title: Stakeholder Communication Norms
records.content: Research readout protocols: 48-hour advance deck sharing via secure link, 30-minute presentation maximum, 15-minute structured discussion. Raw recordings are never distributed; only synthesized insight reports with PII redacted. External attendees require NDA verification before invitation. Follow-up questions routed through Research Ops Request Tracker with 5 business day SLA.
records.author: Linh Nguyen

records.title: Research Data Retention Guidelines
records.content: Recording retention: 36 months from study close date, then automated secure purge unless flagged for longitudinal analysis with Legal approval. Consent forms: 7 years per Colorado state requirements. Compensation records: 3 years for tax audit purposes. Raw field notes: Destroyed within 90 days after synthesis completion and supervisor sign-off. Exceptions require CISO written authorization.
records.author: Linh Nguyen

records.title: Quarterly Planning Rhythm
records.content: Research Ops quarterly cycle: Week 1 - Capacity audit and tool licensing review, Week 2 - Stakeholder priority interviews, Week 3 - Roadmap consolidation and resource allocation, Week 4 - Team calibration and methodology training. Key output: Published research calendar with blackout dates for holidays and company offsites. Capacity assumes 70% research time, 30% ops overhead.
records.author: Linh Nguyen
